# Functional — what every delivered app must DO

## Anti-placeholder (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- No lorem ipsum · no TODO/FIXME/TBD in shipped user-visible strings · no gray placeholder boxes/silhouettes · no "coming soon" without a firm date · no stub/generic images · no "John Doe"/"example.com" · no `[bracket placeholders]` · no single-char labels. Real content, real images, real interactions only.

## Every feature complete (vertical slice)

- Ships end-to-end (UI → API → DB → tests → deploy) — never half a feature across passes. Homepage first (real H1/meta/OG/JSON-LD), deployed before any other route.
- Each feature carries: typed + Zod-validated boundaries · all four states (loading · empty · error · success) · tenant isolation (`org_id` on every row + query; 404 on mismatch, never 403).

## Forms

- Every form submits to a real endpoint (Turnstile + Zod + Amazon SES or D1) and CONFIRMS success. Test an ACTUAL submission — a form that silently fails is a broken feature.

## Notifications

- In-app via psnotify: bell + unread count + center (history/filter/mark-read) + per-channel/per-category preferences. Trigger at meaningful state transitions (build/deploy/domain/AI/billing/team). Toasts ephemeral; the center is the durable record.

## Feature flags

- Every non-trivial / post-launch feature ships behind a typed flag (`enabled=0, rollout=0, stage='experimental'`). Admin promotes via `/admin/feature-flags`. Server guard returns 404 (never 403) when off; UI renders nothing.

## Embarrassingly easy (SUPREME)

- A busy non-technical owner succeeds first try, no manual. ≤3 steps to any outcome · one primary CTA per screen · empty states are first-action launchpads · instant feedback + undo · never a doomed/dead control (disable with the reason + fix, or hide) · the user's words, never internal jargon. Every change leaves the surface easier, never harder.

## Feature catalog (build blocks, as the app needs)

- Admin dashboard · blog/content engine · data tables · site search · file uploads · i18n · PWA (manifest + offline + A2HS) · realtime/websockets · rich-text editor · onboarding/first-run · Cmd+K command palette (every clickable action has a shortcut) · webhooks (signed, verified) · AI chat/copilot · branded 404/500 · custom domains (`{slug}.projectsites.dev` + custom, SSL).

## Real content

- Real photos > AI-generated brand-aligned > none. Real data (API / Workers AI / D1) > mocked. Real testimonials with attribution; cited stats. Never fabricated.

## Multi-Swarm Parallelization & OpenCode (DeepSeek) Offload Mandate

- **Domain Swarm Directive**: Decompose functional feature requests into contract-locked OpenSpec DAG nodes, implementing full plugin catalogs, Settings panels, and domain workflows in parallel via `opencode` (DeepSeek) swarms.
- **Massive OpenCode (DeepSeek) Offload**: Whenever a task slice is throughput-safe (bounded implementation, plugin catalog shards, 100% unit test generation, Playwright E2E specs, migrations, or documentation), offload it to parallel **`opencode` swarms powered by DeepSeek** (`~/.agentskills/bin/opencode-deepseek.sh` via the LiteLLM 4-key pool `https://llm.megabyte.space/v1`) rather than consuming premium `claude`, `codex`, or `gemini` client quota.
- **Tri-Frontier Parallel Swarms & Right-Sized SCRUM Quorum**: When complex architectural synthesis, speculative critical-path racing, or adversarial verification is needed, run `claude`, `codex`, and `gemini` in parallel across isolated Git worktrees (approved host adapters for `bin/evidence-gated-orchestrator.ts`) guided by a right-sized collaborative SCRUM meeting (`bin/scrum-deliberation-quorum.ts`) of only the required specialist agents. - **End-of-Round Parallel Meaning & Preference Triad Extraction (`bin/triad-end-of-turn-sync.ts`)**: At the end of every prompt round (running in parallel with final verification, deployment, and reporting), extract any possible meaning, preference, architectural lesson, reusable site code, or system configuration from the current agent window and store it concurrently into **`heymegabyte/agent-skills`** (for AI skills/rules/prompts — always updated under the **Minimum-Prompt Ecosystem Completeness Assumption**: assuming the skills *should have already been written* so that we write **as few prompts as possible** to finish **as complete a product or multi-repo ecosystem as possible** via massive parallel agent swarms), **`heymegabyte/theme.tools`** (for reusable site/app code across the 28 canonical `@theme.tools/*` libraries), and **`heymegabyte/install.doctor`** (for reusable system/host code).
- **Concurrent End-of-Prompt Delivery Closure**: Run documentation/comment reconciliation and bounded `theme.tools`, `install.doctor`, and `agent-skills` extraction reviews concurrently with proportional tests and release preparation. After reconciling those changes and generated outputs, revalidate the exact final tree. Commit only that tested tree, push it normally to `main`, promote it through the approved production rail, and run production smoke plus critical E2E verification. Fail closed without mutating production when authority, credentials, spending permission, review, recovery, validation, or provenance gates are missing; record the exact blocker instead.
